description: This file defines the TargetBuilder interface, which provides a fluent API for constructing Target objects with various configuration options such as address, topics, authorization, acknowledgements, header and payload mappings.

classes.name: TargetBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building Target objects with a fluent API, allowing configuration of address, topics, authorization, acknowledgements, header and payload mappings.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Sets the address for the target.

methods.name: originalAddress
methods.description: Sets the original address for the target.

methods.name: qos
methods.description: Sets the quality of service level for the target.

methods.name: authorizationContext
methods.description: Sets the authorization context for the target.

methods.name: topics
methods.description: Sets the topics for the target, either as a set or individual topics.

methods.name: issuedAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Sets the acknowledgement label to be automatically issued by this target.

methods.name: headerMapping
methods.description: Sets the header mapping configuration for the target.

methods.name: payloadMapping
methods.description: Sets the payload mapping configuration for the target.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the Target instance.
